summary: This is a Mol Labs public report (N20) proposing a research discussion/hypothesis around whether Bacopa monnieri's working memory and attention phenotype is mediated by AChE inhibition. The document frames an "assumption-kill" experiment: testing whether Bacopa retains ≥50% of its WM/attention effect under a donepezil or AChE occupancy-matched condition that abolishes AChE-class memory rescue. No experiments have been run; the design is at the conceptual/proposal stage (execution_status=NOT_RUN).

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis (N20)
content_blocks.content: On a pre-registered acute/subacute working memory / attention panel with an AChE-class positive memory-rescue arm, a donepezil or AChE occupancy-matched condition that abolishes AChE-class memory rescue, and a Bacopa monnieri arm: under the same condition that abolishes AChE-class memory rescue, Bacopa retains residual working memory / attention phenotype ≥50% of Bacopa-alone (WM / attention units as pre-specified; α/N pre-specified) — assumption-kill / ache-insufficiency.

content_blocks.title: Rationale / Why It Matters
content_blocks.content: Bacopa monnieri is commonly framed via WM/attention phenotypes with AChE activity as an outcome biomarker, but no published study abolishes AChE-class memory rescue with donepezil or an AChE occupancy match and then scores residual Bacopa phenotype on the same panel. N20 asks whether residual Bacopa WM/attention phenotype survives a donepezil/AChE occupancy-matched condition that kills AChE-class memory rescue (ache-insufficiency assumption-kill). Explicitly distinguished from N15 (modafinil-DAT residual), N16 (creatine plasma/PCr), N17 (Hericium×NGF/TrkA), N18 (L-theanine×adenosine), N19 (Rhodiola×HPA/cortisol).

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: AChE-insufficiency assumption-kill: standardised Bacopa monnieri moves human/rodent WM/attention/cognition phenotypes, and some trials measure AChE activity as a biomarker/outcome; no published head-to-head abolishes AChE-class memory rescue with donepezil or an AChE occupancy-matched condition and scores residual Bacopa WM/attention phenotype on the same panel. Preferred design: same-panel acute/subacute WM/attention lock (Peth-Nui/Calabrese/Stough-class human cognition, or Saraf-class scopolamine spatial memory) with AChE-class positive memory rescue ± donepezil or named AChE occupancy-matched abolish condition vs Bacopa ± same condition. Optional cell/SPR overlay only if a named published AChE-occupancy system locks residual first.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art — Literature Evidence
content_blocks.content:
1. PMID 23320031 / DOI 10.1155/2012/606424 — Peth-Nui (2012): 12-week standardised Bacopa monnieri improves attention/cognitive processing/WM and decreases AChE (and MAO) activity in healthy elderly (Evid Based Complement Alternat Med). AChE is an outcome, not a matched abolish arm; not residual-under-block H2H.
2. PMID 21607013 / DOI 10.1093/ecam/neq038 — Saraf (2011): Bacopa monniera attenuates scopolamine-induced impairment of spatial memory in mice (Morris water maze). No donepezil/AChE-occupancy matched abolish arm; no residual H2H.
3. PMID 18611150 / DOI 10.1089/acm.2008.0018 — Calabrese (2008): standardised Bacopa monnieri improves cognitive performance/anxiety/depression vs placebo in elderly (J Altern Complement Med). No donepezil/AChE-matched abolish arm; no residual H2H.
4. PMID 11498727 / DOI 10.1007/s002130100815 — Stough (2001): chronic Bacopa monniera (Keenmind) improves visual information processing/AVLT learning-memory consolidation/state anxiety over 12 weeks (Psychopharmacology). No donepezil/AChE-matched abolish arm; no residual H2H.
5. PMID 33688125 — Prabhakar: Bacopa-vs-donepezil parallel Phase 2b — classified as NON-MATCH (parallel efficacy ≠ residual under occupancy match).

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. N1–N19 do not prove N20 — N15 is residual modafinil PVT under DAT-matched block; N16 is plasma-Cr↑ without ³¹P PCr fails SD WM; N17 is Hericium residual under NGF/TrkA block; N18 is L-theanine residual under caffeine-matched adenosine; N19 is Rhodiola residual under HPA/cortisol-matched challenge; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated residual gain.
2. AChE-as-outcome ≠ residual-under-block H2H — Peth-Nui measures AChE/MAO activity as biomarker/outcome; it does not abolish AChE-class memory rescue with donepezil occupancy match and score residual Bacopa on the same panel. Bacopa-vs-donepezil parallel (Prabhakar) is parallel efficacy ≠ residual under occupancy match.
3. Phenotype priors lack ache-insufficiency arms; lock same-panel acute/subacute WM/attention (prefer named published human or rodent panel; optional cell/SPR after abolish×residual locks) with AChE-class positive memory rescue ± donepezil or AChE occupancy-matched challenge vs Bacopa ± same condition; no dosing; NOT MB/MAOI; not N15/N16/N17/N18/N19 clones; do not burn ip_class=none.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: On the pre-registered acute/subacute WM/attention panel, under donepezil or an AChE occupancy-matched condition that abolishes AChE-class memory rescue, residual Bacopa WM/attention phenotype falls below 50% of Bacopa-alone (WM/attention units as pre-specified) — so AChE-class sufficiency for Bacopa phenotype survives and ache-insufficiency fails — when abolish-gate, Bacopa-alone comparator, and power/assay artifacts are ruled out.

content_blocks.title: Ablation Analysis
content_blocks.content:
Three ablation conditions identified:
1. Remove same-panel contrast of residual Bacopa WM/attention phenotype under donepezil or AChE occupancy-matched condition: Without the abolish×residual H2H on a Peth-Nui/Saraf/Calabrese/Stough-class WM/attention panel with an AChE-class positive memory-rescue arm, separate cognition LITERATURE and AChE-as-outcome LITERATURE cannot show ache-insufficiency.
2. Remove verified abolish gate (donepezil or AChE occupancy match that abolishes AChE-class memory rescue) plus Bacopa-alone comparator: Without verified AChE-class abolish and Bacopa-alone comparator under the same condition, residual Bacopa is just 'another nootropic under nonspecific cholinergic challenge,' not an assumption-kill of AChE-class sufficiency for Bacopa phenotype.
3. Remove N15≠N20 + N16≠N20 + N17≠N20 + N18≠N20 + N19≠N20 + N1–N19≠proof + soft-complete-empty≠novelty + AChE-as-outcome≠residual-H2H + parallel≠residual discipline: Treating adjacent studies or empty PubMed as already deciding residual Bacopa under AChE-matched block would invent an H2H result left UNKNOWN.

key_findings: Execution status is NOT_RUN — no experiments have been conducted; this is a conceptual research proposal at TRL 1.
The core hypothesis (N20): Bacopa monnieri retains ≥50% of its WM/attention phenotype under a donepezil or AChE occupancy-matched condition that abolishes AChE-class memory rescue.

Key gap identified: No published study has performed a head-to-head abolish×residual design (donepezil or AChE occupancy match abolishing AChE-class memory rescue while scoring residual Bacopa WM/attention on the same panel).

Four adjacent literature priors identified (Peth-Nui 2012, Saraf 2011, Calabrese 2008, Stough 2001) — all show Bacopa cognition/WM/attention phenotypes but none include an AChE-class abolish arm; classified as NON-MATCH for the residual H2H design.
Prabhakar (PMID 33688125) Bacopa-vs-donepezil parallel Phase 2b is explicitly classified as NON-MATCH (parallel efficacy ≠ residual under occupancy match).
Matched residual-Bacopa under donepezil/AChE occupancy match that abolishes AChE-class memory rescue is UNKNOWN (soft-complete Q1b/Q2/Q3 empty).

Competing caveats pre-registered: abolish condition fails to kill AChE-class memory rescue / Bacopa-alone null / underpowered strata / assay-identity mismatch — all leave the test inconclusive rather than refuted.
IP class: ache-insufficiency; kill_cost_tier=2; time_to_refute=6 weeks; vault_hold=no.
Status labels: NEGATIVE; polarity: negative; risk_class: research-discussion.
